reference.title: AMP / ASCO / CAP somatic NGS variant tiers & sequencing QC
reference.intro: Classify somatic alterations into AMP/ASCO/CAP Tiers I–IV based on clinical actionability, and verify minimum tumour cellularity (>= 20% for CNV/TMB), read depth (>= 500x for somatic hotspots), and RNA fusion QC.
reference.note: Reference figures are from Wikimedia Commons under open Creative Commons licences. ExpertPath pages open with your own ExpertPath login; the app holds none of their images.

groups.heading: AMP/ASCO/CAP Tiers & sequencing workflow
points: Tier I (Strong clinical significance): FDA/guideline-approved therapy, diagnostic or prognostic marker in this tumour type (e.g. EGFR exon 19 del in NSCLC).
Tier II (Potential clinical significance): approved therapy in another tumour type, investigational clinical-trial target, or emerging biomarker.
Tier III (Uncertain clinical significance — VUS): insufficient evidence; do not use for clinical decision-making. Tier IV (Benign / likely benign): generally not reported.
Verify variant allele frequency (VAF) against estimated tumour cellularity; VAF near 50% or 100% in cancer-predisposition genes (BRCA1/2, MLH1, MSH2, TP53) warrants germline confirmation.
